findings.text: follow-on: the §13 live proof's EDDB half is unmet -- live_proof.log and live_proof_base.log both print HAS_EDDB: False, so search_docs("flux loop","jt-60sa") returns the PSRC flux-loop signals and the BM25 wiki documentation but no EDDB manual chunks; because the marker is identical in the base and head arms this is a graph-state/ranking fact predating this node's change and outside its scope, not a regression the parameter fix introduced.

item_verdicts.diff: read 8736d628d..6eb8cc0e1 commit by commit (single commit 6eb8cc0e1); it renames the fulltext parameter to $search_query, narrows the bare except to (ClientError, DatabaseError), adds three wiki-chunk tests and a 46-line evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when is a regression test driving the wiki-chunk branch through a stub with the real query(query, **params) signature, the live proof still returning PSRC flux-loop signals, and pytest tests/search tests/llm exiting 0; tests/llm/test_search_tools.py:1972 adds the stub-driven test and the manifest records pytest tests/search tests/llm 634 passed EXIT=0 in pytest_search_llm.log, while the live proof holds for the PSRC half and the EDDB half is absent identically in both arms.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that _text_search_wiki_chunks binds its fulltext query text to a Cypher parameter that does not collide with GraphClient.query(query, **params), narrows its swallow to the Neo4j client errors, pins the branch, and re-runs the live proof; imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:905 now binds $search_query and imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:914 swallows only (ClientError, DatabaseError).
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, negative_control_log names a red run (EXIT=1, 2 failing ids), test_logs name pytest_search_llm.log and the base and head live proofs, and baseline_suite/after_suite are empty because this implement-role node ran no armed test-role arm.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py, tests/llm, tests/search and two docs/evidence and docs/figures paths under the plan; the diff touches imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py, tests/llm/test_search_tools.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the declared set.

justifications.durability: tests/llm/test_search_tools.py:1972 is driven through _FulltextSignatureClient whose query(self, query, **params) mirrors Session.run, so binding the text to query again raises TypeError and the assertion at :1976 reddens; negative_control.log confirms this by rebinding and failing 2 tests, and :2031 pins the TypeError propagation of the narrowed swallow.
justifications.evidence: pytest_search_llm.log records 634 passed, 10 skipped, EXIT=0 at 8736d628d with rev/tree/command and module.__file__ header lines, and negative_control.log records EXIT=1 with two failing ids; docked because the reviewed manifest carries no baseline_suite/after_suite arm pair, so added-failure derivation rests on a single after gate.
justifications.fit: imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:905-918 reproduces the signal (:508-520) and code-chunk (:1655-1677) branches verbatim in shape, reuses the module's existing ClientError/DatabaseError import at :18, and commit 6eb8cc0e1 carries a conventional subject and a body.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:905 and :911 bind the wiki-chunk fulltext text to $search_query exactly as the signal branch at :508 and the code-chunk branch at :1655 do, so the parameter collision the goal names is removed; docked one because the done_when's EDDB half of the live proof is unmet (HAS_EDDB: False in both arms).
justifications.reuse: the change extends the existing three-branch fulltext pattern rather than introducing a new mechanism, adding no new definition and reusing the Neo4j exception classes already imported at imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:18.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat 6eb8cc0e1 touches exactly imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py, tests/llm/test_search_tools.py and docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/wiki-chunk-fulltext-parameter.html, all inside the manifest's declared paths; no path outside the set.
